findings.summary: The case table still records case (b)'s criterion as 'file bytes unchanged' while the paragraph added at line 55 and the test at tests/test_a_derived_impl_drops_the_authored_meta.py:220-227 now measure that no write occurred; a reader who takes the table alone gets the weaker claim the previous review rejected.

The mutation log carries no revision line and its tree header reads '/reckon/_store.py', a path that resolves nowhere, so a reader cannot tell which head commit was mutated, and the log is the only evidence that case (b)'s assertion fails under a reinstated regression.
